segments.summary: Reviewed every core line for UF-083 and UF-084 and accounted for both structural and semantic source-unit refs. The requirements preserve valuable guard and exporter boundaries, but leave material runtime contracts open around authority, state transitions, concurrency, recovery, privacy, callers and consumers, GUI truth, scale, cross-document ownership, and executable acceptance.
